title: Schneider--Teitelbaum Duality over a Non-spherically Complete Field
summary: We formulate Schneider--Teitelbaum duality between wide classes of Banach $k$-linear representations of $G$ and left $O_k[[G]]$-modules for a non-spherically complete field $k$, e.g.\ $\mathbb{C}_p$, and a profinite group $G$. We interpret a topological notion of a weak variant of irreducibility of a Banach $k$-linear representation of $G$ into a purely algebraic notion of a certain simplicity of the dual left $O_k[[G]]$-module.
